newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen rising after devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen rising after devaluation.

text.p: Gold is likely to rise in Pakistan this week after last week's 3.79 percent devaluation of the rupee against the dollar, dealers said on Monday.
"Gold rates will automatically rise after the devaluation," said dealer Saeed Qureshi of the All Pakistan Gem and Jewellers Association.
Rates were climbing on fears that the rupee would be further depreciated. "People usually rush to buy gold whenever the rupee falls," Qureshi said.
Silver prices, which jumped after the September 10 devaluation, were likely to remain steady, he said.
